api.live_policy: solve_time rejected with controller; default live path retains ROS policy
api.record_callback: Optional (event, record) read-only observer with record_raw=True; before/after solve and plant substep events are outside solve wall timer.

clock.mode_B_scope: perf_counter wall seconds around solver.solve only, including wrapper work within the call; excludes force-batch updates, recording, statistics, selection and plant integration
clock.alignment: The most recently returned plan is executed in the next plant interval for the wall duration of the solve that produced it. This is the existing tracking preceding-duration approximation, not concurrent integration during the actual call or an exact asynchronous stale-plan replay.
clock.startup: The first task solve starts from the ordinary initial guess (or explicit initial_guess for TIAGo); it is recorded as startup/cold. Startup solve wall/native durations are retained, but first plant interval is nominal dt. This task solve is not the unrelated process/CUDA warm-up required by F01ab; that warm-up must be supplied separately by the experiment.
clock.native_units: solver.solve returns native microseconds; divide by 1000 for milliseconds. Native timing never drives mode B.
clock.substeps: Maximum sim_dt; split at piecewise-constant control-knot boundaries and integrate fractional remainders immediately, with no deferred remainder accumulation.
clock.plan_end: Packed terminal knot is state-only; clamp control selection to knot N-2 and hold the final valid control beyond the horizon.
clock.warm_start: Shift previous selected trajectory by actual elapsed execution interval, then re-anchor first state at measured state; preserve exact shifted solver input.
clock.timeout_mode_B: Clip requested interval at remaining per-goal timeout; preserve requested/realized duration and clipping flag. Record final interval even when it leads to reach/timeout without another solve.
clock.timeout_mode_A: Preserve previous at-update timeout checking without clipping. Canonical .03s intervals on .003s/.001s grids remain the same. Noncommensurate steps now integrate exact fractional remainders rather than defer/drop them; this is a harness correction and changed-setup cohorts must be labeled.
clock.success_check: Check existing goal/dwell gates at updates; task success and physical compliance remain separate.
clock.interval_gate: No strict deadline gate; share of intervals longer than nominal dt is descriptive only. Preserve terminal clipped interval and identify it in summaries.

stats.interval_mapping: interval_plan_solve_indices=0 means startup solve; index1 and later map to feedback solves. All interval arrays include terminal intervals, while feedback solve arrays contain only intervals followed by another solve.
stats.raw_solves: record_raw=True: startup/cold, warm and goal_switch records with state/reference/shifted warm_start/output arrays per lane, simulated timestamp, goal index, solve index, shift seconds, wall seconds, native milliseconds, selected lane and full solver stats when track_full_stats=True
stats.raw_execution: record_raw=True: every simulated substep start time, actual step seconds, plan solve index, measured goal index, augmented control, full state before and after. Live applied controls remain unobservable here; live recorder must retain its separate histories.
stats.persistence: Campaign uses record_raw=True and persists read-only record_callback events into fresh attempt directories with source/build/input/config hashes. self.last_run_stats is available before startup and includes started/completed/failed records and recording_failure if callback raises. Exceptions propagate; native/plant failures are not successful task outcomes.
